what: Request-understanding benchmark: 80 hand-written prompts (40 dev, 40 held-out test), gold labels for intent (design/score/say), modality, count, edit type, objective weights, push, steps, trust gate, locus, compare. A prompt counts only if every labelled field is right.

after_all_fixes.note: test set was used to fix the last 4 misses, so this number is no longer held-out

caveats: Prompts and gold labels were written by the same person who wrote the parser, so this measures regression and coverage, not generalization to strangers. The parser is rule-based, not a language model.
